reason: Reviewer 2 and Reviewer 3 identified orientation and scale defects in the absolute scalar-projection metric. Before revised real-model rescoring, freeze a signed, scale-free directional summary and a common across-model output contract.

affected_decisions.value: target-level signed cosine; context-level median with target bootstrap 95% CI
affected_decisions.rationale: Correctly distinguishes aligned (+1), orthogonal (0), and negated (-1) predictions and is invariant to model-specific positive output scaling.

affected_decisions.value: norm <= 1e-12 is non-estimable for cosine, Pearson, and scalar-projection summaries
affected_decisions.rationale: A zero vector has undefined direction and must not be assigned an artificial recovery score of zero.

affected_decisions.value: AUC of predicted mean-absolute shift for frozen endpoint anchors versus frozen low-information targets, with stratified target bootstrap CI
affected_decisions.rationale: Keeps anchor separation interpretable as an explicitly magnitude-sensitive endpoint diagnostic while direction is assessed separately.

affected_decisions.value: 47 targets by 47 response genes defined by shared_target_axis_membership.tsv
affected_decisions.rationale: This is the maximum existing common scorer-ready axis across all HCC entrants and contexts. It supports exact across-model comparability but not a whole-transcriptome reconstruction claim.

affected_decisions.value: retain the full 48-target frozen endpoint categories and score their intersection with the 47-target prediction contract; do not recompute percentiles/categories
affected_decisions.rationale: SS18L2 is a corrected HCC1143 endpoint anchor absent from the historical common prediction target axis. Recomputing categories after its removal would redefine the benchmark in response to output availability.

affected_decisions.value: per-target RMSE(predicted minus observed) divided by RMS(observed), summarized by target median
affected_decisions.rationale: Makes reconstruction error dimensionless within the frozen common contract while exposing near-zero observed-vector cases as non-estimable.

results_status_at_amendment: Historical raw-endpoint model audits existed. Revised sampling-aware endpoint categories and the A004 metric definitions had not yet been used for a unified real-model rescore.
model_score_blinding_statement: A004 is not preregistration before all model inspection. It freezes reviewer-requested revised definitions before the new unified M3/M4 scoring run; subsequent changes require a dated amendment and cannot be selected from favorable revised scores.
